title: Trademarks
slide_intent: Help a reader distinguish two kinds of reuse: modifying an identity asset and reproducing a product screen. Each has different conditions in the edition’s guidance.
strategic_value: Slack can keep its marks recognizable and direct readers to separate constraints for screenshots.
demonstration: The numbered logo restrictions continue at upper left. A Screenshots subsection below them lists conditions concerning alteration, third-party content and personal information.
practical_value: Use the first list for a proposed change to the logo and the second for a screenshot. Refer back to page 44 for the beginning of the logo provisions.

content_islands.name: Continuation of logo rules
content_islands.spec: Resume the previous page’s numbering in the narrow left column. Keep successive constraints on color, shape, effects and relationships aligned.

content_islands.name: Screenshot provisions
content_islands.spec: Below the logo list, introduce a lettered Screenshots subsection and indent its five roman-numbered clauses.
